items.title: US Government's New AI Chatbot Has a Weird Minecraft Secret
items.summary: Ask the U.S. government's new AI chatbot about Minecraft and it produces a roughly 1,800-word bureaucratic remix of the game's ending poem. It's an easter egg, not a hallucination.
